ideas.pitch: A dashcam-mounted computer vision system that instantly detects illegal lane weaving, tailgating, and improper overtaking on Indian roads, rewarding compliant drivers.
ideas.problem_statement: Urban mobility challenges such as traffic congestion, poor lane discipline, unsafe driving practices, driver fatigue, and distracted driving impacting road safety and travel efficiency.
ideas.title: LaneGuard AI: Real-Time Edge Lane Discipline & Violation Detection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the hackathon's core challenge regarding poor lane discipline and unsafe driving practices while using a proven computer vision and edge AI approach similar to winning industrial safety systems.

ideas.pitch: Low-cost smart intersection nodes using cheap microphones for emergency vehicle siren detection and computer vision for real-time queue length estimation to dynamically alter traffic lights.
ideas.problem_statement: Smarter traffic management in Indian cities, smart traffic signal & congestion management, IoT-based systems to monitor traffic density and identify congestion hotspots in real time.
ideas.title: AeroSignal: IoT Acoustic & Vision Adaptive Traffic Synchronization
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical IoT sensors with real-time algorithmic execution, creating a tangible hardware-software demonstration that stands out among standard web apps.

ideas.pitch: An in-cabin edge AI monitoring tool utilizing facial landmark tracking to detect micro-sleeps and smartphone distraction, providing immediate auditory warnings and logging telemetry for fleet managers.
ideas.problem_statement: Driver fatigue, distracted driving, and unsafe driving practices continuing to impact road safety and the overall mobility experience.
ideas.title: FatigueLens: Driver Drowsiness & Distraction Alert System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent safety issue with a live webcam demo that judges can immediately interact with and test out during judging rounds.

ideas.pitch: A predictive traffic dashboard that ingests crowd-sourced reports and historical congestion metrics to forecast traffic choke points hours in advance using statistical models.
ideas.problem_statement: How can emerging technologies be leveraged to develop an integrated intelligent urban mobility solution that reduces traffic congestion and enables smarter traffic management?
ideas.title: TransitPulse: Multi-Modal Urban Congestion & Incident Forecasting
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous statistical forecasting models to urban data, mirroring the architecture of award-winning AI incident forecasting solutions.

ideas.pitch: A mobile application that uses smartphone accelerometers and GPS to automatically log severe road bumps and potholes, generating a live municipal repair priority map.
ideas.problem_statement: Challenges such as poor infrastructure, unsafe driving practices, and fragmented traffic ecosystems impacting road safety, travel efficiency, and the overall mobility experience.
ideas.title: PotholeMapping: Crowdsourced Road Quality & Hazard Index
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features clear, quantifiable civic impact with a mobile sensor pipeline that is easy to demo live by shaking a phone in front of judges.
